_doc: Yanis V17 camera markers as data (dot = camera position, V = heading / horizontal FOV). Vectorized from the gtadb tiles yanis,17 by tools/yanis_markers.py (OCR of the labels, dot colour = series, V read on the lines; "by eye" = read by hand on 2026-10-18). Frame: gtamaplib world metres (x east, y north; = the V17 tile frame). heading: compass degrees, 0 = north, clockwise (our yaw = -heading). His markers are eyeballed by him: they are his estimate, not measurements. ours.move_*: how far his marker must move to reach our pose (only meaningful when our pose is solved, i.e. ours.from_yanis is false). Markers and drawing: Yanis (map.gtadb.org); ask him before redistributing.
